video_title: PEAK Luka Makes Lakers DANGEROUS + Panic Button Time In Miami?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's historic offensive start to the season
quotes.excerpt: Luka is off to an incredible offensive start to the season.
quotes.quote: Luka is off to an incredible offensive start to the season. The Lakers have the number one offense so far in this season. We saw in the preseason that he was in really good shape, in really good frame of mind. He had a better balanced team with Walker Kessler there. But this is a really best-case scenario we're seeing of Luka. He's putting up huge numbers.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's league-leading shooting volume and efficiency
quotes.excerpt: He's leading the league in field goals attempted, three-pointers attempted, and free throws attempted.
quotes.quote: He's leading the league in field goals attempted, three-pointers attempted, and free throws attempted, and shooting career-high clips in each of those categories. That's a pretty good way to get off to a historic start. He knows exactly what you're doing as it's happening and he makes the right read time after time. If it's single coverage, the right read for Luka a lot of times is launch a step-back, which, again, he's shooting more threes per game, it's early, but he's shooting more threes per game than anybody ever has in an NBA season. And he's hitting 43%.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' floor spacing and offensive strategy around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: Their floor spacing is happening for Luka and Reaves and they're filling the corners with their guys.
quotes.quote: What they did in this particular game against the Heat, all of their makes were either threes or in the paint. They had no mid-range shots in this game, which means that their floor spacing is happening for Luka and Reaves and they're filling the corners with their guys. And that Luka and Reaves are getting downhill on attack, which is exactly the design, the way they want to play. And if it's not them, the ball is going in lob form to Walker Kessler.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's elite passing and decision-making abilities
quotes.excerpt: Luka threw some absolute bullet passes that hit Kessler where all he has to do is catch it.
quotes.quote: Luka threw some absolute bullet passes that hit Kessler where all he has to do is catch it, go up, and finish. There were multiple times that the Heat threw a second body at Luka to force the ball out of his hands high on the floor. And that's problematic too because he's so good at it. Spoelstra said, 'You're not going to fool him.' He knows exactly what you're doing as it's happening and he makes the right read time after time.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's defensive versatility and size
quotes.excerpt: There isn't a defensive coverage that Luka can't take apart because he's so big.
quotes.quote: When you talk to scouts, there isn't a defensive coverage that Luka can't take apart because he's so big. He's just so big. He can see over the top of defenses, he can pass over the top of defenses, he can shoot over the top of defenses.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon stands by his Luka Doncic trade take
quotes.excerpt: Some folks got their feathers ruffled because I said I wouldn't trade Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for Luka.
quotes.quote: Some folks got their feathers ruffled because I said I wouldn't trade Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for Luka, and that's a statement I stand by despite the fact that right after I say that, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope goes 3-of-19 for the Kings, Luka goes for 42 and 13 against the Heat. But I wouldn't trade Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for Shai or Jokic or anybody. The statement was not an anti-Luka statement. He's a perennial All-NBA player, a perennial MVP candidate, who right now is playing the best basketball of his career and he's the best version of himself.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's injury recovery and return status
quotes.excerpt: The Raptors did update Kawhi's status on Tuesday saying that his rehab on his knee has gone well.
quotes.quote: The Raptors did update Kawhi's status on Tuesday saying that his rehab on his knee has gone well and that he is beginning return to play conditioning and they will update it in a week.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's historic defensive performance against the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: He had five steals and drew three charges. An inspirational defensive performance.
quotes.quote: He had five steals and drew three charges. An inspirational defensive performance, as you called it. Becoming the first player to record those defensive stats in a game since player tracking began in 2013-14.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's defensive engagement and effort
quotes.excerpt: When he's locked in and engaged defensively, yes, you're going to protect him.
quotes.quote: When he's locked in and engaged defensively, yes, you're going to protect him. You don't want him getting the toughest defensive assignment. He's not going to be guarding Kevin Durant when they play the Rockets and saying, 'Hey, go shut down KD.' Within a scheme, you protect him and he can be effective. He can be a very good help defender. He's big, you're not going to post him up, he rebounds.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat's defensive struggles and lack of identity
quotes.excerpt: The Heat are not playing great because they're still learning how their offense is going to go.
quotes.quote: The Heat are not playing great because they're still learning how their offense is going to go. Their offense has very mainly been like, 'Give the ball to Giannis and get out of the way.' And literally get out of the way, like go stand at the three-point line. The expectation level for the Heat was that they were going to be an elite defense with Bam Adebayo, who is a stout perimeter defender, with all of the things that Giannis can do defensively, multi-positional defensively. Bam Adebayo is one of the better, one of the best big man defenders in the league. There was an expectation that that was going to be the case. They've been horrible defensively.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's defensive regression
quotes.excerpt: Giannis has not been an impactful defensive player for a few years now.
quotes.quote: Giannis is a former Defensive Player of the Year. Giannis has an incredible resume as a defender. Dirty little secret: Giannis has not been an impactful defensive player for a few years now. Maybe there's a switch he can flip and turn that back on, but he just hasn't been.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The fire extinguisher incident in Miami
quotes.excerpt: I saw a fire extinguisher have a starring role one night in Miami.
quotes.quote: I saw a fire extinguisher have a starring role one night in Miami. That was a different... I remember being at the Heat locker room and waiting to go in the Heat locker room and all of a sudden you saw the paramedics come running down the hall. The game was over. Paramedics are always in the arena in case somebody needs them. At the end of the night, they take their stretcher and go back to the ambulance. Well, they had done that, but they had turned around and come running down the hall with their stretcher. As they walk past the media outside the Heat locker room, you can hear them on their walkie-talkies, 'Visitor's locker room, visitor's locker room.' And I was like, 'Holy bleep.' And I went following them and basically Amar'e Stoudemire was furious and put his hand through, you know, I think he just meant to hit the the case and it going through and just cut his palm something fierce. He had to have stitches right down his palm.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Amar'e Stoudemire's fire extinguisher punch incident
quotes.excerpt: If the fifth playoff game is broken and it was an off-court thing, pretty sure there was a punch.
quotes.quote: If the fifth playoff game is broken and it was an off-court thing, pretty sure there was a punch involved there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Malik Thomas's role and performance for the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: Malik Thomas, the Mavs' second-round draft pick, moved into the starting lineup.
quotes.quote: Malik Thomas, the Mavs' second-round draft pick, moved into the starting lineup. He started in place of Peyton Watson who has a hamstring soreness. The right hamstring, which is the injury that he had twice last year, which basically derailed his season. Kenny Atkinson said they were not overly concerned. I'm concerned. And the Mavs just they don't have the depth at wing. I mean, nobody has the depth at wing, but certainly the Thunder were not crying.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg's unexpected scoring impact
quotes.excerpt: I don't think the league thought he was going to score like this.
quotes.quote: I don't think the league thought he was going to score like this. I don't think the league thought he was going to score like this. He didn't score like this even in Michigan, right? But it's a different it's a different game in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg's rookie season stats and potential
quotes.excerpt: He's top five among rookies in points at 21.5, rebounds at 7.0, assists 3.9.
quotes.quote: He's top five among rookies in points at 21.5, rebounds at 7.0, assists 3.9. Defensively, on ball he can be pretty good. Off ball he can get lost in outer space. You know, he's not a perfect player. He's essentially five years older than the other guys, maybe depending on when their birthdays are, maybe it's closer to four, but he's in the neighborhood of five years older than all those guys. He's older than a lot of guys who are on their second contract, including Jonathan Kuminga.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Oklahoma City Thunder's interest in Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.excerpt: There was a lot of smoke about Oklahoma City being very interested in Yaxel.
quotes.quote: There was a lot of smoke about Oklahoma City being very interested in Yaxel. That would have been a fascinating experiment, that personality without an organization.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori's coaching impact on the Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: You've got veterans that are good dudes, that are leaders, guys like Damian Lillard and Drew Holiday.
quotes.quote: You've got veterans that are good dudes, that are leaders, guys like Damian Lillard and Drew Holiday. But he got the buy-in from Ja, who understands, 'Hey, this is a second chance, this is an opportunity for him to resuscitate his career.' He got the buy-in from Deni Avdija, who Ja comes in and there's Dame and there's Scoot and Avdija is kind of looking around like, 'Okay, how does this work with me?' Micah is making all that work and the guys, they're playing hard for him. And also Dame is bought in. And especially when Ja is there, Dame's the one making the biggest adjustment. He's playing off the ball more than he ever has in his career.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori's coaching competence and team culture
quotes.excerpt: He's absolutely deserving of a head coaching job, and he's proving his competence.
quotes.quote: He's absolutely deserving of a head coaching job, and he's proving his competence. He's proven why he was a guy who was considered one of the premier assistant coaches in the league for a long time and kept getting interviews and interviews and interviews. He finally got his opportunity and he's taking full advantage of it.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The Wizards' slow start and tanking history
quotes.excerpt: They started the full tank. We should look up from the end of the season going backwards.
quotes.quote: They started the full tank. We should look up from the end of the season going backwards. It might have been about four months. It was it was not it was certainly a while. And Darryn Acuff would be the first rookie since Bernard King in '77-'78 to average 20 a game.
